children: OneMedNet regained compliance with Nasdaq's $1.00 minimum bid price requirement after a 10-business-day stretch of closing prices at or above $1.00.
Nasdaq notified OneMedNet of noncompliance April 14, 2026, and gave a compliance grace period to October 12, 2026.
Closing bid price was ≥ $1.00 for 10 consecutive business days from September 29 through October 12, 2026.
Nasdaq issued a notice on October 13, 2026 confirming OneMedNet has regained compliance; matter is closed.
